earlier_sources: https://github.com/googlefonts/googlefontdirectory-hg at 52f780bc9d197280a9f430574e179a5f233c56b6, apache/kranky/: the font as built and its metadata; src/ holds only METADATA_comments.txt, no source.
disclose: The release kerns with a legacy `kern` table (629 pairs) and has no GPOS; these sources kern through a GPOS kern feature, which is how fontc builds kerning. HarfBuzz shapes every kerned pair alike in both (the functional gate). Decided 2026-10-01: releases with an old kern table are accepted and disclosed.

The release has no glyph instructions: its font program defines functions that no glyph calls, and its control value program only turns on dropout control (SCANCTRL 511, SCANTYPE 4). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, and the build is hinted by ttfautohint, as for every release that has a font program: the outlines, spacing and layout are the release's, its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.
